test_title: PYST 9: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct spelling of the incorrectly spelt word.**

He had a round face made jovial by bright, almost boyish eyes and eyebrows ridiculusly small for a man his size.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ridiculously**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence is: **ridiculously**.
 
• Meanings:
 
 
• **ridiculously** (विवेकहीन या असार) - in a manner deserving or inviting
